notes.title: Devlog #2 - Abilities & Benedictions
notes.notes: [p]This is our first post here on steam, we have been very busy working on the game so posting updates took a backseat for now.[/p][p]Going forward I will try to give you all a video every 2 weeks focusing on some aspect of the game. This week we are looking at abilities and benedictions.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Ro6HUgj9MfE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Playtesting[/h2][p]Playtesting should be starting in 2-3 months at most, join our discord (Link below or on game page) if you wish to join.[/p][p][/p][h2]Devlog #01 - Card Editor[/h2][p]For anyone who want to see the first devlog as well you can find it here, the first one focuses on our card editor.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="g_hZlc186i8;full"][/previewyoutube]
